CandidateConfigV1.description: Operator configuration. Model and provider come from here, never from code.

base_sha.description: Exact 40-hex commit the candidate is based on.

publish_remote.description: Already configured remote the candidate branch may be pushed to; `None` disables [`publish`].

repository.description: Absolute path of the Workers repository.

worktrees_dir.description: Absolute directory for candidate worktrees; inside the repository only when git ignores it.

CycleBudgetV1.description: The limits of one cycle, covering every kind of its work.

max_duration_ms.description: Wall time since the cycle was created.

estimated_usd.description: What one grouped question is reserved at.

provider.description: The judge provider (`judge::evaluate` hub routing), e.g. `typesafe`.

LoopConfigV1.description: Everything a cycle needs to spend on the E2E. Nothing has a default: an unconfigured loop selects coverage but dispatches nothing.

admit_executions.description: Whether a finished E2E execution nobody started from the loop opens a cycle on its own. Off, executions (imported CI runs among them) are data the loop reads, and a cycle starts only when a person asks.

candidate.description: The bounded read-only proposal and the isolated candidate actor; absent: a cycle stops before any proposal, inconclusive.

controls.description: Control scenarios every plan also runs and preserves (pass rate and every spec criterion), e.g. `minimal_path`.

estimated_usd_per_run.description: What one run is reserved at before dispatch; an unreported actual cost stays charged at it, never at zero.

history_days.description: Measure from the E2E runs already made instead of dispatching a baseline: the GitHub executions (the release-control campaigns) of the subject completed in the last this many days. Absent: dispatch.

judge.description: Semantic triage of ambiguous findings through `judge::evaluate`; absent: an ambiguous finding stays inconclusive.

max_scenarios.description: Scenarios one plan may run at most.

stack.description: Required for `docker` and `github`; refused for `harness`, which runs on its own stack.

validation.description: The stack that builds the workers under test from a commit; required to validate a candidate. With it, the baseline runs the candidate's base commit.

MinEffectV1.description: The minimum effect a plan freezes for each metric it can target.

StackV1.description: A stack in the E2E's own shape (`ExecutionStack`), e.g. `package://harness` pinned to `commit:<40 hex>` of `iii-hq/workers` path `harness`.

SubjectV1.description: The model the E2E subject runs on. Credentials stay in the providers.

agent.description: Agent profile the subject runs under; absent uses the E2E default.

oneOf.description: No reasoning at all; honoured only where the model advertises `supports_thinking_off` (elsewhere the provider falls back to its own lowest setting, or omits the parameter, and warns).

ValidationConfigV1.description: The E2E stack in the E2E's own shape. Every worker a candidate may change is declared as a `package://<worker>` container with `commit: {commit}`, so both sides build it from their own commit; everything else (Engine, evaluator, unchanged workers) stays fixed.

source_stack_template.description: Stack YAML pinning a source revision; every `{commit}` is replaced by the 40-hex sha.

WhereV1.description: Where the E2E runs a dispatched execution (`ExecutionParameters.where`).

oneOf.description: The E2E's own Harness: observes the current stack, cannot pin a candidate commit.

_caller_worker_id.description: Stamped by the engine on every invocation; callers omit it.
